thread:
tess-cs: FYI — Storix just escalated. After last night's deploy their search/rerank responses lost inline citations and are returning less relevant docs. Customer says previously they'd get doc links + citation snippets, now mostly short, ungrounded answers. Example attached in thread.
raj-eng-ml: ugh — do we have the deploy id/time? was there a change to reranker or output-formatting?
deploy-bot: deploy completed: service=inference-rerank image=redwood/reranker:v2026.3  timestamp=1934566000
kai-support: tagging logs and request ids from the customer: request_ids=[rQf8-44, rQf8-87]. They ran queries at ~1934567002 UTC. Customer included sample query and response (pasted below).
tess-cs: Sample (customer):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{ "query": "How to reset device X model 4 error code 23", "top_k": 5 }
```
Expected: list of docs with citation snippets (source, url, highlighted excerpt)
Actual: single paragraph answer, no sources. Example returned: "Try factory reset..." (no links)
raj-eng-ml: thanks. Quick checklist: 1) model variant  v2026.3 vs v2025.x, 2) reranker scoring weights 3) any output-formatting toggle (cite strip/compact-output). I'll look at the build notes.
olivia-cs: Customer impact: they say it's producing wrong guidance in some cases (safety concern). They're asking for rollback or hotfix. Marking P1.
kai-support: I pulled the request logs — for rQf8-44 the rerank pipeline runtime shows ranker version=v2026.3, rerank_stage=score_and_format, format_flags=0x2 (compact). There's also a note in logs: "citation_truncation=true" for many responses.
raj-eng-ml: that flag shouldn't have been toggled globally. In the deploy notes we added an optimization for token budget: "citation_truncation" to trim long citation blocks when token_budget < threshold. Sounds like the threshold logic may be misfiring for short responses.
tess-cs: any quick mitigation we can propose to Storix? They want either a rollback or a per-customer override.
raj-eng-ml: short-term: we can flip per-tenant config to disable citation_truncation for their tenant id. I'll push a targeted config change. Longer term: investigate why token budget calc flagged these queries.
kai-support: repro steps I used:
1) hit /v1/rerank with sample query
2) set header x-tenant=storix
3) observe response (no citations)
cURL:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Tenant: storix" \
  -d '{"query":"How to reset device X model 4 error code 23","top_k":5}'
```
raj-eng-ml: I pushed a per-tenant toggle to disable citation_truncation for storix. Can someone verify with the customer?
olivia-cs: telling customer we pushed a config override and asking for sample run. I'll update here when they confirm.
kai-support: customer confirms — after config flip they now see citation blocks again in the example. They say recall still slightly lower on long-tail queries; asked if that will be fixed in stable rollback.
raj-eng-ml: next steps: 1) run A/B traffic comparing v2025.x vs v2026.3 scoring on sample prompt set (I'll run overnight eval), 2) audit token_budget calculation and the new optimization gate, 3) examine whether the reranker weights changed unexpectedly. I'll follow up with a short technical summary.
tess-cs: thanks team. I've opened INC-3821 (high) and added Storix contact info. I'll keep customer updated. :pray:
raj-eng-ml: assigning to me and @kai-support for logs. I'll post findings here by EOD.
olivia-cs: noted — keeping customer slack thread warm. :thumbsup:
